items.body_excerpt: Ariel Atkins (ribs) has been listed as PROBABLE by the Sparks for tonight’s game in Minnesota. Atkins took a shot to the midsection yesterday in the middle of the fourth quarter and did not return. After the game, Lynne Roberts said Atkins was being evaluated still.
